title: Verify Ledger description round-trip prerequisite
preconditions: The released Ledger RecordTransactionInput and shared public LedgerContractClient are available.
steps: Run LedgerContractClientTests through the public operation executor; record one valid non-empty control-free OriginalDescription and InitialEvidence, read the transaction with IncludeHistory=false, and compare the immutable input and evidence fields byte-exactly.
expected: Ledger accepts the valid description, returns the same OriginalDescription and InitialEvidence on get, preserves idempotent replay, and exposes no private Ledger handler, store, SQL, or domain type.
